description: Only what Dependabot (.github/dependabot.yml) can't update: the repo's mise tools, the mise version CI installs and the Node major pinned in the image's Dockerfile. Everything else is off so the two bots never open duplicate PRs.

customManagers.description: ARG NODE_VERSION in the image Dockerfile (a major only, e.g. 26)

packageRules.description: Repo tooling in mise.toml (Renovate regenerates mise.lock). Doesn't touch the image or template, so it never releases.
Dependabot bumps the actions themselves; Renovate only takes the mise version passed to jdx/mise-action.
The template test's project config is a fixture, not a dependency.
Moving to a new Node LTS line is a breaking image change (see CLAUDE.md). Node versioning only counts LTS releases as stable, so non-LTS majors are skipped.
prBodyNotes: Before merging: also move the template's `imageVariant` default and proposals in `src/dev/devcontainer-template.json` to the new image major, in this PR.
